component.name: Fluent-View
component.summary: Fluent 设计风格的图片查看器

description.p: Fluent-View is a fast, lightweight image viewer with a Fluent Design interface. It starts directly into a gallery when launched without a file, decodes a broad range of formats (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, SVG, PSD/PSB, camera RAW and more), and ships with an EXIF inspector, slideshow, and thumbnail wall.
Fluent-View 是一款采用 Fluent Design 界面的快速轻量图片查看器。无参数启动时 直接进入图库模式，支持 JPEG、PNG、GIF、WebP、AVIF、HEIC、TIFF、SVG、PSD/PSB、 相机 RAW 等丰富格式，内置 EXIF 信息面板、幻灯片播放与缩略图墙。
